shlokas.full_sanskrit: आदित्यो वै श्रोत्रत्वक्चक्षूरसनघ्राणाः। आदित्यो वै वाक्पाणिपादपायूपस्थाः। आदित्यो वै शब्दस्पर्शरूपरसगन्धाः। आदित्यो वै वचनादानागमनविसर्गानन्दाः। आनन्दमयो ज्ञानमयो विज्ञानमय आदित्यः।
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: आदित्यो वै श्रोत्रत्वक्चक्षूरसनघ्राणाः। आदित्यो वै वाक्पाणिपादपायूपस्थाः। आदित्यो वै शब्दस्पर्शरूपरसगन्धाः। आदित्यो वै वचनादानागमनविसर्गानन्दाः। आनन्दमयो ज्ञानमयो विज्ञानमय आदित्यः।
shlokas.iast_transliteration: ādaitayao vaai śaraotaratavakacakaṣaūrasanagharaāṇaāḥ. ādaitayao vaai vaākapaāṇaipaādapaāyaūpasathaāḥ. ādaitayao vaai śabadasaparaśaraūparasaganadhaāḥ. ādaitayao vaai vacanaādaānaāgamanavaisaragaānanadaāḥ. ānanadamayao jañaānamayao vaijañaānamaya ādaitayaḥ.
shlokas.meaning_english: Aditya indeed is the ear, skin, eyes, tongue, and nose. Aditya is speech, hands, feet, excretory, and generative organs. Aditya is sound, touch, form, taste, and smell. Aditya is speech, taking, walking, excretion, and bliss. Aditya is full of bliss, full of knowledge, and full of wisdom.

shlokas.full_sanskrit: नमो मित्रायभानवे मृत्योर्मां पाहि भ्राजिष्णवे विश्वहेतवे नमः।
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: नमो मित्रायभानवे मृत्योर्मां पाहि भ्राजिष्णवे विश्वहेतवे नमः।
shlokas.iast_transliteration: namao maitaraāyabhaānavae maṛtayaoramaāṃ paāhai bharaājaiṣaṇavae vaiśavahaetavae namaḥ.
shlokas.meaning_english: Salutations to Mitra, to Bhanu, protect me from death. Salutations to the radiant one, the cause of the universe.

shlokas.full_sanskrit: सूर्याद् भवन्ति भूतानि सूर्येण पालितानि तु। सूर्ये लयं प्राप्नुवन्ति यः सूर्यः सोऽहमेव च।
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: सूर्याद् भवन्ति भूतानि सूर्येण पालितानि तु। सूर्ये लयं प्राप्नुवन्ति यः सूर्यः सोऽहमेव च।
shlokas.iast_transliteration: saūrayaāda bhavanatai bhaūtaānai saūrayaeṇa paālaitaānai tau. saūrayae layaṃ paraāpanauvanatai yaḥ saūrayaḥ sao'hamaeva ca.
shlokas.meaning_english: From Surya are beings born, and by Surya they are protected. They dissolve into Surya. That Surya is myself.

shlokas.full_sanskrit: चक्षुर्नो देवः सविता चक्षुर्न उत पर्वतः। चक्षुर्धाता दधातु नः।
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: चक्षुर्नो देवः सविता चक्षुर्न उत पर्वतः। चक्षुर्धाता दधातु नः।
shlokas.iast_transliteration: cakaṣauranao daevaḥ savaitaā cakaṣaurana uta paravataḥ. cakaṣauradhaātaā dadhaātau naḥ.
shlokas.meaning_english: May the divine Savitar be our eye, and may the mountain be our eye. May the creator bestow the eye upon us.

shlokas.full_sanskrit: आदित्याय विद्महे सहस्रकिरणाय धीमहि। तन्नः सूर्यः प्रचोदयात्।
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: आदित्याय विद्महे सहस्रकिरणाय धीमहि। तन्नः सूर्यः प्रचोदयात्।
shlokas.iast_transliteration: ādaitayaāya vaidamahae sahasarakairaṇaāya dhaīmahai. tananaḥ saūrayaḥ paracaodayaāta.
shlokas.meaning_english: We know Aditya, we meditate on the thousand-rayed one. May Surya inspire us.

shlokas.full_sanskrit: सविता पश्चात्तात्सविता पुरस्तात्सवितोत्तरात्तात्सविताधरात्तात्। सविता नः सुवतुसर्वतातिं सविता नो रासतां दीर्घमायुः।
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: सविता पश्चात्तात्सविता पुरस्तात्सवितोत्तरात्तात्सविताधरात्तात्। सविता नः सुवतुसर्वतातिं सविता नो रासतां दीर्घमायुः।
shlokas.iast_transliteration: savaitaā paśacaātataātasavaitaā paurasataātasavaitaotataraātataātasavaitaādharaātataāta. savaitaā naḥ sauvatausaravataātaiṃ savaitaā nao raāsataāṃ daīraghamaāyauḥ.
shlokas.meaning_english: Savitar is behind, Savitar is in front, Savitar is above, Savitar is below. May Savitar grant us all things, may Savitar grant us long life.
Om is the one-syllable Brahman. Ghrini consists of two syllables.

shlokas.full_sanskrit: सूर्य इत्यक्षरद्वयम्। आदित्य इति त्रीण्यक्षराणि। एतस्यैव सूर्यस्याष्टाक्षरो मनुः।
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: सूर्य इत्यक्षरद्वयम्। आदित्य इति त्रीण्यक्षराणि। एतस्यैव सूर्यस्याष्टाक्षरो मनुः।
shlokas.iast_transliteration: saūraya itayakaṣaradavayama. ādaitaya itai taraīṇayakaṣaraāṇai. etasayaaiva saūrayasayaāṣaṭaākaṣarao manauḥ.
shlokas.meaning_english: Surya is two syllables. Aditya is three syllables. This is the eight-syllable mantra of Surya.

shlokas.full_sanskrit: यः सदाहरहर्जपति स वै ब्राह्मणो भवति। स वै ब्राह्मणो भवति।
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: यः सदाहरहर्जपति स वै ब्राह्मणो भवति। स वै ब्राह्मणो भवति।
shlokas.iast_transliteration: yaḥ sadaāharaharajapatai sa vaai baraāhamaṇao bhavatai. sa vaai baraāhamaṇao bhavatai.
shlokas.meaning_english: He who recites this daily becomes a Brahmana. He indeed becomes a Brahmana.
Reciting it facing Surya, one is freed from the fear of great diseases. Poverty is destroyed.

shlokas.full_sanskrit: अभक्ष्यभक्षणात् पूतो भवति। अगम्यागमनात्पूतो भवति। पतितसम्भाषणात्पूतो भवति। असत्सम्भाषणात्पूतो भवति।
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: अभक्ष्यभक्षणात् पूतो भवति। अगम्यागमनात्पूतो भवति। पतितसम्भाषणात्पूतो भवति। असत्सम्भाषणात्पूतो भवति।
shlokas.iast_transliteration: abhakaṣayabhakaṣaṇaāta paūtao bhavatai. agamayaāgamanaātapaūtao bhavatai. pataitasamabhaāṣaṇaātapaūtao bhavatai. asatasamabhaāṣaṇaātapaūtao bhavatai.
shlokas.meaning_english: One is purified from eating forbidden food, purified from forbidden associations, purified from conversing with the fallen, purified from conversing with the untrue.
One should read it at midday facing Surya. One is immediately freed from the five great sins.

shlokas.full_sanskrit: सैषां सावित्रीं विद्यां न किञ्चिदपि न कस्मैचित्प्रशंसयेत्। य एतां महाभागः प्रातः पठति स भाग्यवाञ्जायते।
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: सैषां सावित्रीं विद्यां न किञ्चिदपि न कस्मैचित्प्रशंसयेत्। य एतां महाभागः प्रातः पठति स भाग्यवाञ्जायते।
shlokas.iast_transliteration: saaiṣaāṃ saāvaitaraīṃ vaidayaāṃ na kaiñacaidapai na kasamaaicaitaparaśaṃsayaeta. ya etaāṃ mahaābhaāgaḥ paraātaḥ paṭhatai sa bhaāgayavaāñajaāyatae.
shlokas.meaning_english: One should not praise this Savitri knowledge to anyone at all. The fortunate one who reads this in the morning becomes fortunate.
He acquires cattle. He understands the meaning of the Vedas. Reciting this at the three times of day, one obtains the fruit of a hundred sacrifices.

shlokas.full_sanskrit: यो हस्तादित्ये जपति स महामृत्युं तरति। स महामृत्युं तरति। य एवं वेद। इत्युपनिषत्।
shlokas.sandhi_split_sanskrit: यो हस्तादित्ये जपति स महामृत्युं तरति। स महामृत्युं तरति। य एवं वेद। इत्युपनिषत्।
shlokas.iast_transliteration: yao hasataādaitayae japatai sa mahaāmaṛtayauṃ taratai. sa mahaāmaṛtayauṃ taratai. ya evaṃ vaeda. itayaupanaiṣata.
shlokas.meaning_english: He who recites it to Aditya with folded hands crosses over great death. He crosses over great death. He who knows this. Thus the Upanishad.
